evidence.summary: Lowering history_score from 900 to 350 raised the score from 0.859 to 0.991. Below that the score falls again (300: 0.9886), so the optimum is near 350.
Score peaks near x8=37 (0.9842) and falls on both sides (45: 0.9779, 50: 0.9691). At history_score=900, x8 of 60/50/40 gave 0.807/0.837/0.854.
Moving tenure_years from 40 to 35 raised the score from 0.9714 to 0.9822. 30 is lower (0.9808), and 33-36 are all around 0.991 at the tuned settings.
Score rises from x6=15 (0.9663) to 18 (0.9714) and falls at 20 (0.9675). 18 and 19 tie at 0.9922.
Rising badge_age_days from 18 to 25 raised the score slightly (0.8537 to 0.8587). Near the optimum, 24 beat 25 and 26 (0.9922 vs 0.9913 vs 0.9903).
Raising x7 from 0 to 1 to 2 lowered the score (0.9675, 0.9662, 0.9597). 0 is best.
anomaly_ratio at 0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05 and 0.1 all gave exactly 0.9822. Values near 1 were never tested in isolation.
clearance_level at 80, 95 and 100 all gave exactly 0.9714.
escorts at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 all gave exactly 0.9714.
